text.p: Tropical Storm Hannah, with 50 mph winds, is in the Philippine Sea near 9n/134e, moving west northwest at 13 mph. Hannah will intensify to near 60 mph during the next 24 hours then is expected to weaken. It is a threat only to shipping, though early in the period rain squalls will occur in the Yap Islands.

Tropical Cyclone Pancho, with 85 mph winds, is in the southern Indian Ocean near 12s/95e, moving south at 5 mph. A turn to the southwest is expected as the storm intensifies. Top winds are expected to reach 100 mph in about 24 hours. Pancho is a considerable threat to shipping.

Tropical Cyclone Gretelle, with 50 mph winds, is about 300 miles north northwest of Mauritius Island in the southwestern Indian Ocean near 17s/56e, moving west southwest at 6 mph. Gretelle is expected to intensify with top winds reaching 70-80 mph during the next 36 hours. Gretelle is mainly a threat to shipping at this time.
